# Run diagnostic tests

<small>Source: [`man/test.HeteroDiagnostic.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/test.HeteroDiagnostic.Rd) · Help: `?test.HeteroDiagnostic`</small>

Run the registered diagnostics on the model.

## Usage

```r
test(object, ...)
```

## Arguments

`object`
:   A `HeteroDiagnostic` object.

`...`
:   Further arguments passed to the individual tests.

## Value

List of test results.

## Deprecated

`test()` is deprecated since 0.14.0: its name masks `devtools::test()`. Use `runDiagnostics(x$model, x$data, tests)`, which returns what `test(x, tests)` returns. It still works and warns; `summary()` of a `HeteroDiagnostic` object is unchanged.
